# Trimble Geospatial Field Data (Jobs)

- **Product:** Trimble Geospatial Field Data (Jobs) (Geospatial family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 (Trimble Identity, id.trimble.com). Declared security schemes: Trimble Identity.
- **Access:** Customer.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Identity token with the jobs service scope.
- **Documented servers:** `https://cloud.api.trimble.com/geospatial/jobs-service/1.0/`.
- **Definition:** [geospatial/field-data-v1](https://cloud.api.trimble.com/geospatial/jobs-service/1.0/openapi/OpenApi3_0.yaml) (Jobs Service, version 1.0.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimble.com/docs/geospatial/reference/openapi/field-data/v1/, https://developer.trimble.com/docs/geospatial/reference/openapi/field-data/v2/.
